villagemaster/30565.htm.text: Flame Lord Kakai: Hear me! I am Flame Lord Kakai, invested with the authority of Pa'agrio, the father of eternal flame, to lead the great Orc race. Young warrior, you are to my eyes like a flame of hope, hope that our race may yet achieve its former glory. What do you wish from me?

links.text: Listen to information about second class transfer.

villagemaster/30565-1.htm.text: Flame Lord Kakai: Originally, we Orcs consisted of seven powerful tribes and reigned over the entire world. But about 2,000 years ago, we engaged in a large scale war against those despicable Elves. Of course, the superiority of our race over any other was unquestionable -- which is undoubtedly why…

Q00217_TestimonyOfTrust/30565-01.html.text: Flame Lord Kakai: I am Kakai, the Flame Lord and warrior of the heavens! I, with the authority of Pa'agrio, lead the great Orc tribe with the power of the holy flame. Weak Human, why do you appear before me?

Q00217_TestimonyOfTrust/30565-03.html.text: Flame Lord Kakai: Kakai has spoken! Go and find Seer Manakia ! Leave at once for the Town of Giran!

Q00217_TestimonyOfTrust/30565-04.html.text: Flame Lord Kakai: My prediction has proven false, young Human. Take this charm and leave. This is a totem exchanged by Orc tribes to strengthen alliances and relationships! This is merely a symbolic gesture, a chance for you to prove your trustworthiness. Now you must try to earn the trust of those…

Q00217_TestimonyOfTrust/30565-05.html.text: Flame Lord Kakai: Why are you still here? Did you not agree to meet those shifty Dwarves? Be careful! All they believe in are things that glitter and sparkle... The trust that Lockirin, head of the Dwarves speaks of may not be what you think.

Q00220_TestimonyOfGlory/30565-01.html.text: Flame Lord Kakai: The seal of the glorious warrior tribe has been stolen from the heart of our kingdom! I have no need for the seals of lesser tribes from the outskirts. Now go away!
when: state STARTED; has items 3220,3235; lacks items 3237

Q00220_TestimonyOfGlory/30565-02.html.text: Flame Lord Kakai: You have found the Scepter of the Tantos tribe! I hope this appeases the angry souls of the Tantos ancestors, even if it does not entirely wash away all our sins. I have heard that the Ragna tribe was behind this whole thing. Is this true? First they betrayed us; now they challeng…

I see that you have received acknowledgement from the Chiefs of the 5 tribes! Good! You are now eligible to take the final test! I, Kakai, Chief of…

Q00232_TestOfTheLord/30565-09.html.text: Flame Lord Kakai: What, have you not left yet?! Visit Ancestor Martankus in the Cave of Trials! Hurry! The one who hesitates forfeits the right to become an Overlord!

Q00232_TestOfTheLord/30565-10.html.text: Flame Lord Kakai: Since the days of old, the ancestral spirits have tested all of the tribal Chiefs and Lords before bestowing authority upon them. The time for your test has come! Complete the task that the ancestral spirit Marutankus has for you in order to prove your potential of becoming a Lord!

Once a slave, always a slave, right? In that case, if you are begging for help, I will not refuse you. However, there is a price that must be paid. Don't be frigh…
